mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Wapping E1W to Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book online through our secure platform, call our team directly, or complete a quick reservation in minutes. All Wapping E1W bookings receive instant confirmation with driver details and a guaranteed fixed price.

mainEntity.name: How far is Wapping E1W from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wapping E1W is approximately 16 miles (26 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A13, A4, and M4 corridor. Journey times typically range from 40 to 65 minutes depending on traffic through the City and along the Heathrow approach roads.

mainEntity.name: What is the minicab fare from Wapping E1W to Heathrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Wapping E1W to Heathrow saloon fare starts from £65 with a fully fixed price. The airport pickup fare is slightly higher at £70 to include terminal waiting and parking allowances.

mainEntity.name: Is Meet and Greet available at Heathrow for Wapping E1W passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our complimentary Meet & Greet service is available at all four Heathrow terminals. Your chauffeur waits in the arrivals hall with a personalised name board and assists with luggage before your transfer to Wapping E1W.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab available 24 hours a day from Wapping E1W?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Wapping E1W minicab service operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week including public holidays, with no out-of-hours surcharges applied to any booking.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab an affordable Heathrow transfer from Wapping E1W?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LTR Minicab provides competitive fixed-price Heathrow transfers from Wapping E1W from £65 for a Saloon. All fares are locked in at booking with no surge pricing, meter additions, or hidden charges.

mainEntity.name: Which airports can I travel to from Wapping E1W?

acceptedAnswer.text: We operate direct transfers from Wapping E1W to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City, and Southend Airport with fixed fares and professional licensed chauffeurs.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer group transfers from Wapping E1W?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide MPV 5, MPV 6, MPV 7, and MPV 8 vehicles for families and groups travelling from Wapping E1W to airports, hotels, and UK destinations.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover Wapping High Street and surrounding E1W areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We cover all streets within E1W including Wapping High Street, Wapping Lane, Wapping Wall, Tobacco Dock, and surrounding riverside residential buildings and warehouse conversions.

mainEntity.name: Is the Wapping E1W minicab service available on weekends and bank holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Wapping E1W minicab service runs every day of the year including weekends and all UK bank holidays at no additional cost.
